description: This PHP source file is related to session handling in the ADODB database abstraction library, specifically involving session encryption with MD5. It ensures backward compatibility by setting a filter for the ADODB session to use MD5 encryption.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: Class responsible for session management within the ADODB library. The filter method is used here to set session filtering with encryption.

classes.name: ADODB_Encrypt_MD5
classes.description: Class that implements MD5 encryption for session data.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Static method of ADODB_Session to set or apply a filter, in this case, for session encryption.
